text: Last month, I earned $3.55 per thousand views. This month, $0.10. That is roughly 95% drop. Same content, same audience, same effort. TikTok, we need to talk. Now let me show you what that actually means. Since May 3rd, I have lost any additional rewards. I've still posted 17 videos. Combined, they've gotten close to 9 million views, over a million likes, almost 8,000 comments. By every metric, this has been one of the strongest stretches my channel has ever had. And you know how much I earned on these 9 million views? Roughly $300. On 17 videos, and almost 9 million views. That's around $0.35 per thousand views. Not even the $0.10, $0.11 TikTok claims. Because TikTok only pays for qualified views, which can be only 1 out of every 3, 4, 5 views. Now look, I'm not here just to complain about money. I'm actually relatively lucky. I have a full-time job, I work in finance, I'm well-paid. For me, TikTok is a hobby. One I take seriously and hope to make my main occupation one day. But for now, I can live without this income. But think about every other creator out there. The ones who quit their jobs for this. The ones who put everything on the line. Who sacrificed everything just to make content. How are those guys supposed to survive this? Another problem is that TikTok won't even address my complaint. I have close to 200,000 followers, on average around a million views per day. And I still can get help from TikTok. They simply closed my ticket without addressing the issue. That's why I'm making this video. And before I go further, I want to be clear about something. I'm not here to bash TikTok. I'm genuinely grateful for this platform. Compared to Instagram, compared to YouTube, TikTok helped me to grow the most, to build this channel. That's exactly why I'm asking them to fix this. Because I care. But if I can't get an answer, what chance does a creator with 10,000 followers have? What chance does someone who just started have? They have none. And that's the part that's not okay. TikTok, we need to talk. So this is for every creator watching right now, small and big. Stitch this video, share your RPM, show your numbers, show what your last week looks like compared to last month. Doesn't matter what niche you're in. Doesn't matter what your views look like. We're all in the same boat here. And if you're seeing the same thing I'm seeing, say it out loud. Let's actually see how big this problem is. Because right now, we're all sitting in our corners thinking it's just us. But it's not just us. TikTok, please tell us what changed. If it's a policy, please name it. If it's a flag, please explain it. If something is temporarily not working properly, please say so. Because the silence, that's the part that's not helping anybody. So guys, if I may ask you for your support, please share this. Put it in your story. Tag a creator you follow. Not just for me, but for every creator who can't make this video themselves. And if you're with me on this, write something in the comments to push the algorithm. If you don't know what to write, just drop your selfie, some other photo, or a meme, and a phrase or a hashtag. TikTok, we need to talk. Let's flood it. Let's make sure they actually have to look. And whatever TikTok says back, if they say anything, I plan to openly share with you. TikTok, we need to talk.
